chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Maymūn narrated with his chain of transmission; he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: "If you lose your way, then turn to the right."
ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruct to do when a person loses the road?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a concise instruction from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding what to do when one loses the way. It reflects a Prophetic practical teaching in which turning to the right is presented as the recommended course in such a situation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2517 - Abdullah ibn Maymun narrated with his chain of transmission that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"If you lose your way, turn to the right."
